gloss: thanks to you; fortunately; I'm happy to say

definitions.gloss: thanks to you; thanks to your help; owing to your kindness
definitions.explanation: A polite expression used when acknowledging someone else's help or influence in a positive outcome. Expresses gratitude for the other person's support.

definitions.gloss: fortunately; happily; I'm glad to say
definitions.explanation: Used as a polite conversational opener when reporting good news, even when the listener did not directly contribute to the outcome. A humble way of sharing positive developments.

examples.japanese: おかげさまで⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧です。
おかげさまで⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}しました→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to you, I passed safely.

examples.japanese: おかげさまで⟦{商売|しょうばい}→商売：03239_shoubai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{順調|じゅんちょう}→順調：03282_junchou⟧です。
examples.english: I'm happy to say that business is going well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{皆様|みなさま}→皆様：15860_minasama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧おかげさまで⟦{開店|かいてん}→開店：14569_kaiten⟧10⟦{周年|しゅうねん}→周年：09520_shuunen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できました→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to all of you, we have been able to celebrate our 10th anniversary.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧？」「おかげさまで、⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やっています→やる：02980_yaru⟧。」
examples.english: "How have you been?" "I'm doing well, thank you for asking."

examples.japanese: おかげさまで{子|こ}ども⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I'm glad to say the children have grown up.

notes:
A polite set phrase composed of ⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧ (thanks to, owing to) and ⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧ (honorific). Widely used as a conversational expression when reporting positive news. Even when the listener had no direct role in the outcome, using おかげさまで shows humility and social grace by attributing good fortune to the support of others.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
The most frequent use is as a response to "How are you?" or similar greetings: おかげさまで⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧です literally means "thanks to you, I am well," but functions as a polite "I'm fine, thank you."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- おかげさまで + positive statement: the standard pattern
- [noun]⟦の→の：09472_no⟧おかげさまで: explicitly naming who you are thanking
- ⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧さま⟦をもちまして→をもちまして：22962_womochimashite⟧: very formal version used in speeches and announcements

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: thanks to — less formal, can also be used sarcastically for negative outcomes
- ⟦{皆様|みなさま}→皆様：15860_minasama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: thanks to everyone — slightly less formal than おかげさまで
- ありがたいこと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: thankfully, gratefully — more focused on the speaker's feelings
